title: Warm Zesty Brazilian Onion Skewers
description: A tangy and light Brazilian dish featuring onions, perfect for a low sodium diet, this recipe is energizing and full of flavor. The combination of citrus and spices creates a truly unique taste experience.

ingredients.name: onions
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into 1 inch pieces

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika, salt-free seasoning blend, and black pepper.
Add the onion pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated onion pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the onions are tender and lightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the grill and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the skewers warm, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
